## HOW TO USE THIS FILE

### Before starting ANY task:
```
1. Search FIXES.md for tags related to your task
2. Search Notion ECKB via MCP for deeper context
3. Apply known fix patterns BEFORE attempting new solutions
4. If no fix found → proceed → then LOG the fix here after
```

### Fix Entry Format (COPY THIS TEMPLATE):
```markdown
## FIX-[###] | [YYYY-MM-DD] | Agent: [Name] | Severity: [LOW/MED/HIGH/CRITICAL]

**Error:** [exact error message or description]
**File/Location:** [file path or system area]
**Project:** [NovaLearning / MediClaimSA / Consulting / All]
**Context:** [what were you trying to do when this happened]

**Root Cause:**
[One clear sentence explaining WHY it broke]

**Fix Applied:**
```[language]
// BEFORE (broken)
[broken code or config]

// AFTER (fixed)
[fixed code or config]
```

**Prevention Rule:**
> [One sentence rule all agents must follow going forward]

**Tags:** #tag1 #tag2 #tag3
**Notion Link:** [paste Notion page URL after syncing]
**Validated By:** [Agent name who confirmed fix works]
**Status:** ✅ Active | ⚠️ Partial | ❌ Deprecated
**Related Fixes:** FIX-[###], FIX-[###]
```

---

## SEVERITY GUIDE

| Level | When to use | Response time |
|-------|-------------|---------------|
| CRITICAL | App crashes, data loss, blocks all agents | Fix NOW, notify all agents immediately |
| HIGH | Feature broken, blocks current project | Fix within current session |
| MED | Workaround exists but ugly | Fix when convenient, log immediately |
| LOW | Minor annoyance, cosmetic | Log and batch fix |
